purpose: Resolve frozen Stage 2 occurrence display provenance to actual repository banner assets, census the two approved asset roots, and materialize occurrence/definition asset relations without changing canonical banner identity.

resolutionPolicy.lookup: exact basename inside the root selected by occurrence.display.imageType
resolutionPolicy.assetId: basset:v1:<first 24 lowercase hex chars of SHA-256(file bytes)>
resolutionPolicy.exactByteDuplicates: share one assetId and are reported as multiple repository paths
resolutionPolicy.nullImageFile: MANUAL_ASSET_REQUIRED; do not synthesize a filename
